tip.tipsmod.welcome: MineOctober: Get your pumpkins ready, grab your pickaxe, and stock up on candy!
tip.tipsmod.spooky: Ghosts and creepers fear your torch... we hope.
tip.tipsmod.pumpkin: A pumpkin on your head won't make you smarter, but it will hide you from Endermen.
tip.tipsmod.candy: Pro tip: Don't eat mysterious candy found in caves. Or... maybe do?
tip.tipsmod.night: October nights are long and full of horrors. Don't leave home without a sword.
tip.tipsmod.friend: If a skeleton offers you a bone, it might mean friendship... or a duel.
tip.tipsmod.loot: The best loot is the kind that won't bite your head off when you pick it up.
tip.tipsmod.build: Build a cozy cabin with a fireplace. Otherwise, someone (non-player) might move in.
tip.tipsmod.portal: October is the perfect time to tidy up the Nether—or unleash chaos there.
tip.tipsmod.cat: A black cat brings luck. Or bad luck. Either way, it's cute.
tip.tipsmod.boss: If you hear an ominous laugh, run. Or prepare to fight. The choice is yours.
tip.tipsmod.lore: Ancient inscriptions say: 'He who doesn't decorate his home shall be robbed by zombies.'
tip.tipsmod.treasure: Mysterious chests whisper... Check for traps before opening!
tip.tipsmod.magic: Enchant everything that moves. Well, and your gear too.
tip.tipsmod.rain: October rain perfectly masks the sound... of footsteps behind you.
tip.tipsmod.hamster: A cute hamster in your pocket is the best anti-stress remedy against creepers.
tip.tipsmod.graves: Graves are the creepiest way to remind you to be more careful.
tip.tipsmod.ghast: Not all ghosts want to set you on fire. Some are just sad.
tip.tipsmod.archeology: When digging up antiquities, be ready to unearth more than just pots.
tip.tipsmod.foes: This October, some mobs might surprise you with new tactics... or new faces.
tip.tipsmod.critters: Not all creatures are scary. Some just want a friend.
tip.tipsmod.ribbit: Frogs in hats. They exist. It's not a myth.
tip.tipsmod.affinity: October magic amplifies your spells. Or distorts them. Who knows...
tip.tipsmod.creeper_overhaul: If you hear a new hiss, it's not a surprise—it's a warning.
tip.tipsmod.grave_loot: Your grave might become the richest stash on the server. Too bad it won't be for you.
tip.tipsmod.hamster_friend: A hamster may look cute, but when angry, it's scarier than any zombie. Don't provoke it.
tip.tipsmod.ancient_danger: Sometimes you need an archaeology brush not for pottery, but to scrape flesh off bones.
tip.tipsmod.spooky_companion: Even on the scariest night, it's less lonely with a friend.
tip.tipsmod.illusion: What looks like a cute rabbit might actually be an Illusioner. Trust, but verify.
tip.tipsmod.animal_growing: Feeding baby animals speeds up their growth.
tip.tipsmod.arthropods: The 'Bane of Arthropods' enchantment also increases damage against silverfish, endermites, and bees.
tip.tipsmod.azalea_caves: Azalea trees grow above lush cave biomes.
tip.tipsmod.baby_panda_slimeball: Baby pandas have a very rare chance to drop a slimeball when they sneeze.
tip.tipsmod.barrel: Barrels are a convenient alternative to chests.
tip.tipsmod.bed_explode: Trying to sleep in other dimensions will end badly.
tip.tipsmod.bed_respawn: Sleeping in a bed sets your spawn point.
tip.tipsmod.biome_bonemeal: Using bone meal on grass blocks can produce different types of flowers.
tip.tipsmod.biome_fishing: Fishing in jungles can yield different items compared to fishing in other biomes.
tip.tipsmod.blaze_fuel: Blaze rods make excellent furnace fuel.
tip.tipsmod.blaze_snowball: Blazes take damage when hit by snowballs.
tip.tipsmod.bucket_friends: Fish and axolotls can be safely collected using buckets.
tip.tipsmod.coarse_to_dirt: Coarse dirt can be converted into regular dirt using a hoe.
tip.tipsmod.compass_spawn: Compasses point toward your world's spawn point.
tip.tipsmod.cooked_drops: Animals killed by fire damage usually drop cooked food.
tip.tipsmod.creeper_cat: Creepers are afraid of cats and will flee from them.
tip.tipsmod.creeper_drops_disc: Creepers drop a music disc when killed by a skeleton's arrow.
tip.tipsmod.crouch_blocks: Sneaking prevents you from falling off block edges.
tip.tipsmod.deflect_ghast_fireballs: You can deflect Ghast fireballs by attacking them.
tip.tipsmod.dog_health: The lower a dog's tail, the less health it has left.
tip.tipsmod.dog_rotten_flesh: You can heal wolves by feeding them rotten flesh.
tip.tipsmod.dripstone_lava: Pointed dripstone under lava will slowly drip lava particles. This can be used to fill a cauldron.
tip.tipsmod.elytra_boost: Using fireworks while flying with elytra can boost your speed!
tip.tipsmod.end_dimension: You cannot leave the End without defeating the Ender Dragon... or dying.
tip.tipsmod.enderman_blocks: Endermen can move blocks like dirt, sand, and TNT!
tip.tipsmod.enderman_projectiles: Endermen cannot be hit by projectiles.
tip.tipsmod.enderman_pumpkin: Wearing a carved pumpkin reduces the chance of an Enderman noticing you.
tip.tipsmod.enderman_stare: Endermen become hostile if you look them in the eyes.
tip.tipsmod.endermites: Endermites can spawn when an Enderman teleports or when an Ender Pearl is used.
tip.tipsmod.fall_damage_blocks: Certain blocks, like water and hay bales, reduce fall damage.
tip.tipsmod.fortress_triangulation: You can triangulate fortress locations by summoning Eyes of Ender from two different spots and tracking where their paths intersect.
tip.tipsmod.fossils: Large fossils can be found beneath swamps and deserts.
tip.tipsmod.four_eggs: Hatching a chicken egg can very rarely produce four chicks.
tip.tipsmod.freezing_leather: Leather armor can protect against freezing damage.
tip.tipsmod.goat_milk: Goats can be milked using a bucket.
tip.tipsmod.gravity_torch: Falling blocks like sand and gravel instantly break when landing on a torch.
tip.tipsmod.iron_golem_heal: Iron Golems can be healed by giving them iron ingots.
tip.tipsmod.job_site_dimension: Villagers lose their job site when changing dimensions.
tip.tipsmod.lava_fuel: Lava buckets can be used as furnace fuel.
tip.tipsmod.locked_repeaters: Repeaters can be locked and held in their state by powering their sides with another repeater.
tip.tipsmod.lure_animals: Animals will follow you if you hold food they like.
tip.tipsmod.mean_goats: Be careful around goats—they love knocking players and other animals off cliffs.
tip.tipsmod.mooshroom_lightning: Red mooshrooms turn brown and brown mooshrooms turn red when struck by lightning.
tip.tipsmod.mushroom_biome_spawns: Hostile mobs don't spawn on mushroom islands.
tip.tipsmod.mushroom_placement: Mushrooms cannot grow under direct sunlight.
tip.tipsmod.nether_lava: Lava spreads faster in the Nether.
tip.tipsmod.nether_sponge: Wet sponges instantly dry when placed in the Nether.
tip.tipsmod.nether_travel: Traveling one block in the Nether equals traveling eight blocks in the Overworld.
tip.tipsmod.note_block_instrument: The sound a note block makes changes depending on the block beneath it.
tip.tipsmod.obsidian_formation: Obsidian forms when water touches a lava source block.
tip.tipsmod.ore_tiers: Mining certain ores requires a pickaxe of a minimum tier.
tip.tipsmod.piglin_repellent: Piglins are scared of soul fire blocks, including soul torches and soul lanterns.
tip.tipsmod.poison_immune: Zombies, skeletons, and spiders are immune to poison damage.
tip.tipsmod.portal_trick: You can create a simple Nether portal using buckets of water and lava.
tip.tipsmod.scrap_nuggets: Old gold and iron gear can be smelted into nuggets.
tip.tipsmod.shear_mooshroom: You can shear a mooshroom to turn it into a regular cow.
tip.tipsmod.sheared_cave_vines: You can shear the tips of cave vines to stop their growth.
tip.tipsmod.shears_dispenser: You can place shears in a dispenser to shear sheep automatically.
tip.tipsmod.shulker_armor: Shulkers take significantly less damage when their shells are closed.
tip.tipsmod.smoke_bees: Bees can be calmed by placing a campfire under their hive.
tip.tipsmod.snow_golem_trail: You can collect infinite snowballs from a snow golem's trail.
tip.tipsmod.spider_jockey: Skeletons can rarely ride spiders into battle!
tip.tipsmod.sponge_bucket: A wet sponge can be dried in a furnace. If an empty bucket is in the fuel slot, it will catch the water!
tip.tipsmod.string_wool: String can be crafted into wool.
tip.tipsmod.swamp_slime: Slimes can spawn in swamps during a full moon.
tip.tipsmod.turtle_shell: Turtles only drop scutes when a baby grows into an adult.
tip.tipsmod.undead_damage: Undead mobs take damage from healing potions and are healed by harming potions.
tip.tipsmod.undead_helmet: Undead mobs won't burn in daylight if they're wearing a helmet.
tip.tipsmod.wandering_invis: Wandering Traders drink invisibility potions at night.
tip.tipsmod.water_grass: Water can quickly break grass blocks to obtain seeds.
tip.tipsmod.wax_copper: Honeycombs can be used to wax copper blocks, preventing oxidation.
tip.tipsmod.weather_sleep: Sleeping clears the sky and stops storms or rain.
tip.tipsmod.west: The sun, moon, and stars move westward.
tip.tipsmod.witch_conversion: Villagers turn into witches when struck by lightning.
tip.tipsmod.wooden_tool_fuel: Old wooden tools can be used as furnace fuel.
tip.tipsmod.zombie_armor: Zombies take slightly less damage than most other mobs.
tip.tipsmod.no_rush: There's no rush. Enjoy the moment and build at your own pace.
tip.tipsmod.autumn_coziness: Autumn is the season for coziness. Why not build a cabin with a fireplace and a warm atmosphere?
tip.tipsmod.scenic_view_treasure: Sometimes the greatest treasure is the scenic view from a mountain peak.
tip.tipsmod.mistakes_are_ok: Mistakes are okay. Any build can be redone, and any path can be restarted.
tip.tipsmod.looking_for_ideas: Looking for ideas on what to do? Press F4 to open the quest book and get inspired!
tip.tipsmod.build_your_shop: Want to share your goods? Build your own shop! Trading is a great way to grow your settlement and community.
tip.tipsmod.best_project_is_shared: The best project is a shared one. Join a village build or start something new with friends.
tip.tipsmod.visit_other_shops: Visit other players' shops—you might find useful items and make the owner happy.
tip.tipsmod.write_your_story: Write your story in a book! Maybe our books together will form a library <3
tip.tipsmod.imagination_is_limitless: Game mechanics are limited. Your imagination isn't.
tip.tipsmod.imagination_is_powerful: The most powerful thing in the game is your imagination. Use it!
tip.tipsmod.best_resource_is_story: The best resource in the game isn't diamonds—it's a good story.
tip.tipsmod.beautiful_path: Sometimes the most beautiful path isn't the shortest one.
tip.tipsmod.watermill_location: The best place for a watermill is by a real river. Let the world around you inspire your build.
tip.tipsmod.landscape_coauthor: Let the landscape become your co-author. Nest your house into a mountainside or bridge a canyon.
tip.tipsmod.ask_why_build: Ask yourself not just 'what' to build, but 'why.' The answer will make your world deeper.
tip.tipsmod.imagine_as_resident: Imagine yourself as a resident of this world. What would you build for comfort and beauty?
tip.tipsmod.imagine_as_traveler: Imagine yourself as a traveler. What story will you write in your journal today?
tip.tipsmod.imagine_as_historian: Imagine yourself as a keeper of history. What legend will you preserve in a book for future generations?
tip.tipsmod.where_to_rest: Where would you rest after a long day? Invite neighbors to build such a place together.
tip.tipsmod.house_is_a_story: Your house isn't just a storage room for resources. What story does it tell about you?
tip.tipsmod.resident_eyes: See the world through a resident's eyes. What does this place need for true happiness?
tip.tipsmod.what_is_your_legacy: What legacy do you want to leave in this world?
tip.tipsmod.first_sunlight_window: Where do the first rays of sunlight fall? That might be the perfect spot for a window.
tip.tipsmod.believable_world: A world you believe in is more interesting than one you've simply 'completed.'
tip.tipsmod.building_village_together: What's better than building a village? Building it together with friends!
tip.tipsmod.details_create_atmosphere: Details create atmosphere. A lantern by the door, a flower on the windowsill—and your house comes alive.
tip.tipsmod.function_and_beauty: Functionality and beauty can go hand in hand. Let your farm be not only useful but also picturesque.
tip.tipsmod.gift_for_friend: Leaving a helpful trinket in someone else's chest is the best way to say 'hello' and make a friend.
tip.tipsmod.ask_for_help: Need help or advice? Don't hesitate to ask in chat.
tip.tipsmod.every_block_has_history: Every block you see was placed by someone. Behind every build lies its own little story.
tip.tipsmod.bright_moments_together: The brightest moments happen when we're together. Join our weekly events every weekend!
tip.tipsmod.weekend_plans_event: Got weekend plans? We've got a community event!
tip.tipsmod.event_idea: Have an idea for a celebration, competition, or group build? It could become our next weekly event!
tip.tipsmod.become_an_author: Anyone can be an adventure author. Share your event idea in our Discord, in the 'ideas' channel!
tip.tipsmod.events_by_players: Our weekly events are created by players, for players. Co-author next weekend—submit your idea!
tip.tipsmod.closed_gate_safety: A closed gate ensures your peace of mind—and your pets' safety. (c)Luna
tip.tipsmod.tamed_wolf_friend: A tamed wolf is a loyal friend. A wild wolf near your farm is a potential problem. (c)Luna
tip.tipsmod.mineoctober_once_a_year: Other games can wait. MineOctober happens only once a year! (c)Max
tip.tipsmod.cave_navigation_torches: Simple way not to get lost in caves: always place torches on your right. On the way back, they'll be on your left. (c)Evgeny
tip.tipsmod.mineoctober_is_a_marathon: MineOctober is a marathon, not a sprint. Pace yourself to enjoy every moment. (c)Max
tip.tipsmod.safe_bee_smoking: Care about your bees? Place a block over the campfire under the hive. Smoke will rise, but bees stay safe. (c)korikofox
tip.tipsmod.dont_dig_up: Hear dripping from above? Don't dig up—there could be a lot of water... or lava. (c)Evgeny
tip.tipsmod.drakkar_shields_bug: Patterned shields mounted on a drakkar can fall off due to bugs. And that would be really disappointing. (c)Gumkar
tip.tipsmod.no_floating_trees: Don't leave tree canopies floating in midair. Ran out of axes? Build a hill instead. (c)yngv4rr
tip.tipsmod.community_help: Don't be afraid to ask questions and make friends. Our community is always ready to help! (c)Hiryur
tip.tipsmod.friendly_community: Feeling awkward? It'll pass quickly. You'll be surprised how many open and friendly people are here. (c)Hiryur
tip.tipsmod.white_robe_villager_luck: They say a villager in a white robe brings luck—if left undisturbed. Just wish them a safe journey. (c)Aviz
